title: Model European conditional descriptor bank zero
changes: Add a strict conditional EUR model for descriptor pointer0 and bank0 rows 1 through 15, preserving row0 and arbitrary guest selectors.
validation: One isolated Windows build and focused Wine test passed source reconstruction and shape/source guards, original predicate and initializer, mode3 pointer/bounds, and conditional first/last record scans.
limitations: These are conditional original-code checks, not observed ordinary use; managed/runtime, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance measurements.
